Maker Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate marketing or promo videos from your own images and clips, with automatic music and transitions.
- No editing skills needed: just describe your desired result and upload assets (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB).
- Fast cloud rendering returns high-quality video files in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic API setup with anonymous token support and session management.
- Simple commands for uploading assets, exporting videos, viewing balance, and checking project state.
